facts.fact: 十个人一个接一个倒地。
facts.anchor: The people drop one at a time until ten have hit the floor.

facts.fact: 他们抽搐，她知道绿血会被发现。
facts.anchor: They writhe and seize up, and I know the green blood will be found.

facts.fact: Bran 是唯一被她救下的人。
facts.anchor: Bran shudders beside me. The only one I was able to save.

facts.fact: Sherry 的话在她脑中回响。
她认为自己的选择能让 Olive 更安全。
facts.anchor: She’s safer if I make this choice.

facts.fact: 她喊出爱他和他们所有人。
facts.anchor: “I love you, Orzo!” I shout at him. “All of you!”

facts.fact: 她意识到爱不足以解决这件事。
facts.anchor: Unfortunately, love isn’t enough to fix this.
I run as far and fast away as I can.
